intro: Codex and Claude Code are complementary tools — different strengths for different moments in your workflow.

items.title: Reach for Claude Code when...
items.body: You need complex multi-step reasoning, architectural decisions, large codebase exploration, MCP tool integration, or want a conversational back-and-forth to refine ideas.

items.title: Reach for Codex when...
items.body: You need precise bounded edits, CI/CD automation in full-auto mode, bulk changes across many files, or scripted pipelines that run without human interaction.

items.title: Use both together
items.body: Claude Code: plan and design. Codex: implement the mechanical parts. Claude Code: review the changes with /review. Codex: fix the issues.
